items.description: the stock_records Alembic migration can be downgraded and re-upgraded in a single step against the real branch database without error (@pytest.mark.migration, never targeting the base revision)
the boundary module (app/routes/) does not import the database session object
the service module (app/services/) contains no SQLAlchemy ORM import of any kind
the boundary module (app/routes/) contains no SQLAlchemy ORM import of any kind
the DATABASE_URL used to connect to the database is sourced from the environment with no connection string hardcoded in any source file under app/
POST /api/stock with a uuid-suffixed SKU, a location, a quantity, and an inventory_code returns 201 and the record is retrievable from the real branch database
a direct INSERT into stock_records that omits a NOT NULL column is rejected by the real branch database
GET /api/stock/{sku}/{location} returns the stored quantity and inventory_code with exact fidelity matching the previously filed values
no route handler in app/routes/ invokes a server-side template renderer
the pytest integration suite connects to the DATABASE_URL of the real Lakebase branch as verified by inspecting the active database engine driver
a direct INSERT into stock_records with a (sku, location) pair already present in the test's own seeded rows raises a unique-constraint violation on the real branch database
a second POST to /api/stock for the same (sku, location) pair updates the stored record in place so exactly one row exists for that pair in the real-branch database
two concurrent transactions each attempting to file the same (sku, location) pair produce exactly one row in the test's own delta on the real branch database
a direct INSERT into stock_records with quantity set to -1 is rejected by the CHECK constraint on the real branch database
the service layer raises an error before any repository call when the requested quantity would be negative
when an in-place upsert updates a stock_records row for a colliding (sku, location) pair the row's created_at value is identical before and after the upsert
an invalid file-stock request produces an error response whose payload names the specific offending field
the file stock form renders through App mounted in MemoryRouter at the /stock route
the file stock form's input fields carry their design-guide data-testid seams
the file stock form's submit button carries its design-guide data-testid seam
the stock retrieval view renders through App mounted in MemoryRouter at the stock retrieval route
the stock retrieval view's quantity display element carries its design-guide data-testid seam
the stock retrieval view's inventory_code display element carries its design-guide data-testid seam
submitting the file stock form for an existing SKU and location pair shows no error message in the UI
